name: Sibmah
overview: Sibmah, also known as Shebam or Shibmah, is identified in Scripture as a city within the territory of the tribe of Reuben (Numbers 32:3, 38; Joshua 13:19). The prophetic passages in Isaiah and Jeremiah lament the devastation of Sibmah’s vineyards, symbolizing the judgment and desolation brought upon this region (Isaiah 16:8-9; Jeremiah 48:32). These verses emphasize the sorrow over the loss of fruitfulness and the impact of foreign oppression, highlighting God's sovereign involvement in the history of His people and their land.
